preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalnum() or c.isdigit() for c in input)
preconditions.description: The string must contain only alphanumeric characters or digits.

postconditions.expression: output == ''.join([c.lower() if c.isupper() else c for c in input]).replace('_', '')
postconditions.description: The output must be the input string converted to snake_case.
If the input is a number, the output must be the string representation of the number.
